<!DOCTYPE html><html lang="vi"><head><meta charset="utf-8"><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1,maximum-scale=1,user-scalable=no"><meta name="robots" content="noindex, nofollow"><title>🧪 Xếp nước theo màu</title><style>
*{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0}html,body{height:100%;overflow:hidden;background:#0f172a;color:#fff;font:16px system-ui,sans-serif;touch-action:none;user-select:none;-webkit-user-select:none}
canvas{display:block;width:100%;height:100%}
#h{position:fixed;top:8px;left:0;right:0;text-align:center;font-weight:700;pointer-events:none;padding:0 8px}
#bar{position:fixed;bottom:10px;left:0;right:0;display:none;justify-content:center;gap:8px}
#m{position:fixed;inset:0;background:#0f172af2;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;padding:10px;text-align:center;overflow:hidden}
#g{--b:min(calc((100vw - 28px)/10 - 4px),calc((var(--vh,100vh) - 190px)/10 - 4px),42px);display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(10,var(--b));gap:4px}
#g button{width:var(--b);height:var(--b);padding:0;font-size:max(11px,calc(var(--b)*.4))}
@media(max-height:520px) and (orientation:landscape){#g{--b:min(calc((100vw - 28px)/20 - 4px),calc((var(--vh,100vh) - 150px)/5 - 4px),40px);grid-template-columns:repeat(20,var(--b))}.hint{display:none}}
button{background:#38bdf8;color:#04202e;border:0;border-radius:8px;padding:10px 14px;font:inherit;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer}button:disabled{background:#2b3350;color:#7b86aa;cursor:default}button.cur{outline:2px solid #fff}
</style></head><body><canvas id="c"></canvas><div id="h"></div><div id="bar"><button id="bu">↶ Hoàn tác</button><button id="br">↺ Làm lại</button><button id="bn">☰ Chọn màn</button></div><div id="m"></div><script>
const C=c.getContext('2d'),N=100,K='mg_watersort',T='🧪 Xếp nước theo màu',hint=matchMedia('(pointer:coarse)').matches?'Chạm ống để nhấc, chạm ống khác để đổ nước. Chỉ đổ được lên màu giống hoặc ống trống. Mỗi ống chỉ còn một màu là thắng':'Click ống (hoặc ← → rồi Space) để nhấc, rồi click ống đích để đổ. Chỉ đổ được lên màu giống hoặc ống trống. U hoàn tác, R làm lại';
let W,H,lv=1,run=0,best=1,lt=0;try{best=+localStorage[K]||1}catch(e){}
function rs(){W=c.width=innerWidth;H=c.height=innerHeight;document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--vh',H+'px')}onresize=rs;rs();
function menu(){run=0;bar.style.display='none';m.style.display='flex';m.innerHTML=`<h2>${T}</h2><p>Chọn màn (${best}/${N})</p><div id="g"></div><p class="hint" style="opacity:.7;max-width:92vw;font-size:14px">${hint}</p>`;for(let i=1;i<=N;i++){const b=document.createElement('button');b.textContent=i;b.disabled=i>best;if(i==best)b.className='cur';b.onclick=()=>go(i);g.append(b)}}
function end(w,t){if(!run)return;draw();run=0;if(w&&lv>=best&&best<N){best=lv+1;try{localStorage[K]=best}catch(e){}}bar.style.display='none';m.style.display='flex';m.innerHTML=`<h2>${w?'🎉 Qua màn '+lv:t||'💥 Thua rồi'}</h2><button id="ba">${w&&lv<N?'Màn tiếp':'Chơi lại'}</button><button id="bm">Chọn màn</button>`;ba.onclick=()=>go(w&&lv<N?lv+1:lv);bm.onclick=menu}
function go(l){lv=l;m.style.display='none';bar.style.display='flex';rs();init();run=1;lt=performance.now()}
function loop(t){lt=t;if(run)draw();requestAnimationFrame(loop)}

const CL=['#ef4444','#22c55e','#3b82f6','#eab308','#a855f7','#f97316','#06b6d4','#ec4899','#84cc16','#e5e7eb','#a16207','#14b8a6'];
let Tb,cap,hs,sel,mc,cu=0,kb=0,R=[],T0;
const ok=()=>Tb.every(t=>!t.length||t.length==cap&&t.every(x=>x==t[0]));
function init(){const nc=Math.min(3+((lv-1)/7|0),12);cap=lv<30?4:lv<60?5:6;Tb=[];for(let i=0;i<nc;i++)Tb.push(Array(cap).fill(i));for(let i=0;i<(lv>=85?1:2);i++)Tb.push([]);
for(let k=nc*cap*3+lv,g0=0;k>0&&g0<99999;g0++){const a=Tb[Math.random()*Tb.length|0],b=Tb[Math.random()*Tb.length|0];if(a==b||!b.length)continue;const c0=b[b.length-1];let s=0;while(s<b.length&&b[b.length-1-s]==c0)s++;const kk=1+(Math.random()*s|0);if(kk==s&&b.length>s)continue;if(a.length+kk>cap||a.length&&a[a.length-1]==c0)continue;for(let i=0;i<kk;i++)a.push(b.pop());k--}
if(ok())return init();T0=JSON.stringify(Tb);reset()}
function reset(){Tb=JSON.parse(T0);hs=[];sel=-1;mc=0;cu=0}
function pour(a,b){if(a==b||!Tb[a].length)return;const A=Tb[a],B=Tb[b],c0=A[A.length-1];if(B.length&&B[B.length-1]!=c0)return;let s=0;while(s<A.length&&A[A.length-1-s]==c0)s++;const n=Math.min(s,cap-B.length);if(!n)return;hs.push(JSON.stringify(Tb));for(let i=0;i<n;i++)B.push(A.pop());mc++;if(ok())end(1)}
function tap(i){if(!run||i<0||i>=Tb.length)return;if(sel<0){if(Tb[i].length)sel=i}else{pour(sel,i);sel=-1}}
function undo(){if(run&&hs.length){Tb=JSON.parse(hs.pop());sel=-1;mc--}}
function draw(){C.clearRect(0,0,W,H);const nt=Tb.length,per=nt<=7?nt:Math.ceil(nt/2),rows=nt<=7?1:2,ah=H-140,uh=Math.min((ah/rows-34)/cap,34),th=uh*cap+10,tw=Math.min(W/per-10,58),sp=Math.min(W/per,tw+18),y0=44+(ah-rows*(th+30))/2;R=[];
Tb.forEach((t,i)=>{const r=i/per|0,cn=r<rows-1?per:nt-per*(rows-1),x=W/2+(i%per-(cn-1)/2)*sp-tw/2,y=y0+r*(th+30)-(sel==i?14:0);R.push([x,y,tw,th]);C.strokeStyle=kb&&cu==i?'#fff':'#94a3b8';C.lineWidth=3;C.beginPath();C.roundRect(x,y,tw,th,10);C.stroke();t.forEach((v,k)=>{C.fillStyle=CL[v];C.beginPath();C.roundRect(x+4,y+th-5-(k+1)*uh,tw-8,uh-2,5);C.fill()})});
h.textContent=`Màn ${lv} · ${Tb.length} ống · Lượt ${mc}`}
c.onpointerdown=e=>{const i=R.findIndex(([x,y,w,h2])=>e.clientX>=x-6&&e.clientX<=x+w+6&&e.clientY>=y-10&&e.clientY<=y+h2+10);kb=0;tap(i)};
onkeydown=e=>{const k=e.key;kb=1;if(k=='ArrowLeft')cu=Math.max(0,cu-1);else if(k=='ArrowRight')cu=Math.min(Tb.length-1,cu+1);else if(k==' '||k=='Enter'){e.preventDefault();tap(cu)}else if(k=='u'||k=='U')undo();else if(k=='r'||k=='R')reset()};
bu.onclick=undo;br.onclick=reset;

bn.onclick=menu;menu();requestAnimationFrame(loop);
</script></body></html>
